proposals.before: The Emperor and the Khitan had originally no pact of friendship; after the Last Emperor pressed him, he sent his trusted man He Fu with a knife and file as tokens of faith; with one word the other came personally to his distress, swift as flowing lightning—is this the trust of Heaven's intent!

proposals.reason: The particle 信 means 'truly' here, not the noun 'trust'; 信天意耶 asks whether the swift rescue was Heaven's intent.
